proposedContribution.contract: Implement the normative base.previewSchemaMigration(input), base.applySchemaMigration(digest), base.resumeSchemaMigration(checkpoint) through the accepted command transport. Request binds canonical schema ref, expectedSchemaRevision, old/new descriptor with stable fieldId, explicit operation kind (label rename, portable key rename, type conversion, soft delete), conversion policy, authorized source snapshot hash and per-row ref/revision. Mutation uses operationId through the accepted command envelope. Actor/policy/workspace authority comes from transport, not trusted payload fields.
proposedContribution.preview: Read only currently authorized rows and dependencies; emit typed diff, valid/coercible/invalid results, unit/timezone/cardinality and formula/relation/export impacts, permitted samples and immutable digest binding policy/source/schema/row preconditions. Preserve original raw/source hash for each repair item. Preview has no effects.
proposedContribution.applyAndResume: Reauthorize, jointly check schema and each row revision under owner-supported fence/transaction, revalidate changed rows, write journal stages/checkpoints via the accepted authority, and return migration/skip/conflict receipts. Keep new schema pending until its defined activation condition is satisfied; invalid/unmigrated rows must remain explicitly repairable under source version, not silently read as valid converted values. Resume reuses operation IDs and checkpoints with native readback to distinguish applied-but-unacknowledged writes. Mixed owners use declared bounded transaction/saga support, not a global atomicity claim.
proposedContribution.rollback: Journal schema/portable-key mappings and expected native revisions. Rollback is a compensating mapping/adapter operation preserving later acknowledged commands; never restore a whole old task/source snapshot over newer writes. Source backups are evidence/repair input, not the new canonical task store.
proposedContribution.renderer: Use the existing Base surface and accepted transport/query contracts to show impact, counts, source/revision/hash, invalid raw repair values, pending/committed/skipped/conflict progress, resume and bounded rollback. No localStorage migration journal or second records grid. t() for all copy; user theme, Rox font, keyboard/IME and reduced-motion support. Mutation success only after durable receipt and authoritative readback.

risks: Shared note-views.ts is also a dependency integration seam; these hashes may become stale during lead integration. Never apply this sketch against old line numbers without fresh source.
Missing schema/row fence can lose a newer edit even when per-file rename is atomic. Current personal put does not take an expected revision.
Parsed YAML is not the original portable source. Re-serialization or conversion-to-null can destroy unknown properties/comments/BOM/EOL and invalidate repair evidence.
A whole-source backup restore can erase later acknowledged commands; rollback must use lineage/mapping and bounded native CAS.
Hidden rows must not leak through valid/coercible/invalid counts, samples, formula/relation impacts, export or progress events; ACL must be rechecked on apply/resume/revoke.
A TSX module alone is not a reachable Electron surface. Existing writable scope does not establish transport registration, UI mounting or translations.
Published RS-BASE-01 and LSX reference design differ on baseline and CustomRecord authority model. Introducing parallel stores/kinds to satisfy both would violate scope and canonical ownership.
